retrievalProfile.description: A moody, nocturnal portrait featuring a central figure in Western attire against a deep blue swamp landscape with glowing highlights and a framed floral motif.

recipe.visualDefinition: A painterly composition dominated by deep teals and blacks, featuring a man in a Western-style shirt with bright blue yokes. He is positioned in the right foreground, leaning on a small framed painting of a blue magnolia. The background depicts a moonlit swamp with gnarled trees, hanging moss, and a small cabin, all rendered with a soft, airbrushed glow.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in right foreground balanced by a large dark tree on the left
Luminous blue accents on clothing echoing the moonlit highlights in the landscape
Framed floral element acting as a secondary focal point at the bottom center
Deep atmospheric perspective created by layered silhouettes of swamp flora
coreInvariants: Deep teal and midnight blue color palette
Spanish moss hanging from silhouetted trees
Soft, diffused lighting on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium-close portrait of a man occupying the right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit blue magnolia in the small frame at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face down to the framed flower, then sweeping left into the dark swamp landscape.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and dark, filled with atmospheric textures rather than empty space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Midnight blue and deep teal (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan and bright blue (shirt yokes and flower petals)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and pale yellow moonlight
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between dark silhouettes and glowing highlights; saturation is concentrated in the blues.
paletteRestrictions: Limit greens to dark, desaturated forest tones

letterConstructionRules: Fluid, handwritten feel with sharp terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature sweeping, elongated flourishes
Lowercase letters are tightly spaced and uniform

composition.relationshipToImage: floating above the dark tree line
integrated into the upper dark space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Elegant script paired with a wide-tracked, minimalist geometric sans-serif for contrast.
graphicDevices: Wide letter spacing in the subtitle to create a sense of horizon

preserve: Wide tracking of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, casual but elegant 70s vibe
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a painterly nocturnal swamp scene in deep teals and blues. Include a man in the right foreground wearing a Western shirt with bright blue yokes, leaning on a small framed painting of a blue magnolia. The background should feature a moonlit cabin and trees with hanging moss.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, elegant white cursive script at the top center. Below it, add a line of all-caps geometric sans-serif text with very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the script slanted and fluid?
Is the secondary text all-caps with wide tracking?
Is the text color pure white against the dark background?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue glow on the shirt
Visibility of the cabin in the background
Slant angle of the script typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between the figure and the landscape

postGenerationChecks: Does the image feel like a 1970s oil painting?
Is the blue magnolia frame clearly visible?
Is the lighting atmospheric and nocturnal?
Does the typography sit cleanly in the upper third?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a medium-close portrait in Western attire with a nocturnal bayou landscape, using a teal-heavy palette and elegant script typography.
